$comment: Sites that splice the `https://jmrp.io/#person` node into their own @graph.
All of them read the canonical document from raw.githubusercontent at build
time, and since 2026-09-15 that is the only copy there is: the committed
`person.snapshot.json` fallback was removed from every one of them, and with
it the commit this repository used to push on each change. A consumer build
that cannot read the canonical document now fails instead of publishing a
stale identity, which is what makes keeping no copy safe.
`dispatchWorkflow` is that repository's docs build, and dispatching it IS the
propagation now. It must accept `workflow_dispatch`; nothing else about its
triggers matters any more, so the push-filter inspection that used to decide
between a commit and a dispatch is gone with the rest.
A consumer may be listed before its repository is public: the script reports
it as `not published` and moves on, so the entry is already there on the day
Adding a consumer is adding an entry here.
